purpose: Teach: 色素/躍動/網膜/植林/海中/調剤/産卵/堆積

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、色素鑑定を、警察、依頼されますね
lines.en: So for this case, the police would request a pigment analysis, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, tentative. Opens with mild curiosity, not certainty. Slightly hesitant pacing—testing an idea, not presenting fact. Soft rise at the end, genuinely seeking confirmation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、防犯ドラマの躍動シーンを参考にされる事は無いでしょう
lines.en: The police wouldn't base their approach on how crime dramas stage their action sequences.
lines.style: Dry, measured reply. Light undercut of wry humor. Speaking from experience—unbothered, slightly tired. Matter-of-fact delivery that doubles as gentle correction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、網膜認証突破事案を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: And for this case, the police would investigate the retinal authentication breach, right?
lines.style: Same thoughtful tone as before. Shifts to a new angle, building on the earlier pattern. Quiet confidence underneath the tentative framing. Genuine interest in the answer.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、植林計画地での違法投棄を取り締まります
lines.en: The police handle enforcement on illegal dumping in reforestation zones as well.
lines.style: Steady, procedural. Speaking from institutional knowledge. No doubt, no wry edge—just factual. Professional but not distant. A small nod to competence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、海中での失踪事件を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So the police would handle a disappearance case in the open ocean, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Returns to the earlier tone—thoughtful, testing. Slightly slower pace, respectful of the seriousness of the scenario. Genuine question beneath the politeness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、調剤薬局窃盗事件にも対応します
lines.en: The police respond to pharmacy theft cases too.
lines.style: Flat, comprehensive statement. Building a list. Professional register, no editorializing. Simple, clear, faintly exasperated—how many cases do you need to hear about?

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、ウミガメの産卵地保護違反を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So the police would investigate violations of sea turtle nesting site protection, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Same reflective pattern. Quieter now—slightly absurd premise starting to show through Ren's politeness. Slower delivery, faint thread of bemusement. Still respectful.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地層の堆積物分析が捜査の決め手になります
lines.en: Sediment layer analysis from the geological strata becomes the decisive evidence in the investigation.
lines.style: Closer, more certain. Slight shift—Takeda seems to see where this is going. Firmer ground, clearer authority. Speaking with the weight of actual investigative method. Measured, patient.
